name: discover/discover-hero
title: DiscoverHero
summary: The top of every Discover page: breadcrumbs, an eyebrow, the page's one <h1>, a lead, the search box and the actions. Larger on the home page.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short label above the title (the service, or "Category").

props.name: count
props.description: A short count beside the actions, e.g. "1,204 circles on Mukoko".

props.name: crumbs
props.description: Breadcrumbs; the last one, with no href, is the current page.

props.name: size
props.description: `home` is larger (display title on wide screens).

slots.name: actions
slots.expects: Links styled as buttons, or OpenInApp
slots.description: The hero's actions, e.g. "Create a circle".

behaviour: The title is the page's only <h1>.
Breadcrumbs are a named <nav> and an ordered list; the current page is plain text with aria-current="page".
The background is the brand wash (`gradient-showcase`).

Server-filled shells: every text prop is a plain string, and text that fills to "" hides itself (`empty:hidden`), so the component can be built once with `{{placeholders}}` and filled by a server (circles.mukoko.com's Rust Worker).

props.title: Find your people. Keep them close.

keyboard: Through the breadcrumb links, then the slots.
aria: Breadcrumb nav is labelled "Breadcrumb"; the current crumb has aria-current="page"; the separators are aria-hidden.

theming.brandOverlay: The wash (`gradient-showcase`) mixes `--primary` into the background, so it follows the brand overlay. Nothing else is brand-coloured.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Text is capped at the prose measure; the title balances its lines.
Padding grows from 48rem; on the home page the title steps up to the display size.
contract:
contract
  slot is "discover-hero"
  when default shows h1 "Find your people. Keep them close."
  when default shows p "1,204 circles on Mukoko"
  when page shows a "Circles"
  when template shows h1 "{{heading}}"
  when template shows p "{{eyebrow}}"
end
